purpose: Historical legally documented monetary outcomes, not a measure of toxic harm, fault, mortality or an additive company score.

USD.method: US CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, annual mean (NSA); reference 2025. 2025 BLS annual average omits October due to the federal funding lapse.

BRL.method: IBGE national IPCA calendar-year December/December rates (2001–2025) compounded from the year after the nominal disposition year through Dec. 2025. For the 2000 Petrobras spill cases the 2000 payment year is corroborated by contemporary reporting; the resulting 2025 BRL figures are standardized calendar-year purchasing-power comparisons, not legal interest or a settlement adjustment. The 2021 Vale agreement was signed in February; use of Dec. 2021 as the notional base remains an annual-calendar comparator only.

CAD.method: Statistics Canada annual-average, not seasonally adjusted, Canada all-items CPI (2002=100), 2025 reference. Canada-dollar comparisons only, no exchange-rate conversion.

INR.method: India national CPI Combined (rural + urban), all items, 2012=100, 2025 calendar-year comparator. Annual indices are arithmetic means of the twelve government-published monthly index levels, rounded to three decimals. 2025 reconstructed Jan–Mar from RBI fiscal 2024-25 and Apr–Dec from RBI fiscal 2025-26. Distinct payment years must be inflation-adjusted separately; not contractual interest, legal compensation or FX conversion.

payment.detail: US DOJ Environment and Natural Resources Division FY2012 accomplishments report explicitly says the second-largest U.S. coal supplier PAID a $4m civil Clean Water Act penalty for four mining complexes, identifying US v. Arch Coal, Inc. The agreement had been announced March 1, 2011. DOJ FY2012 publication does not establish the exact cash-transfer year, so '2011' is used only as obligation-year CPI comparator.

cases.notes: Arch Coal renamed Arch Resources in May 2020, and merged with CONSOL in January 2025 to form Core Natural Resources. Those corporate identity events postdate all 2011 enforcement conduct: do NOT claim Core committed the earlier violations or directly paid the $4m. DOJ's estimated prevention of 2m lbs annual pollution and monitoring/selenium control costs are not separate verified cash penalties.
